name: Selvedge Denim Trucker Jacket
description: A raw selvedge-denim trucker jacket in deep indigo with a pointed collar, twin chest flap pockets, and copper rivets and buttons throughout.
materials: 14oz raw selvedge denim, copper rivets and buttons
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, logo, wordmark, or printed/embossed marking anywhere on the jacket; never distress, fade, or wash the denim; never swap the copper hardware for another metal finish; never add a corduroy collar or waxed finish; keep any interior label completely blank and unprinted. Exception: a mark, wordmark, or label that the brief's art direction explicitly names is deliberate and must be rendered exactly as directed — the text bans above apply only to invented marks the art direction never asked for.
preservationNotes: Keep the trucker-jacket silhouette (pointed collar, twin chest flap pockets, button cuffs), the raw unwashed deep-indigo denim tone, and the copper hardware identical and consistent across every angle; denim weave, color saturation, and hardware finish must match exactly from front to back to detail to on-form.
